meta.name: Planet Outlaws
meta.description:
Buck Rogers and his pal Buddy (Jackie Moran) are released from suspended animation after 500 years. 
They discover that the world is under the thumb of modernistic mobster Killer Kane (Anthony Warde), and are enlisted in the fight against Kane by Wilma Deering (Constance Moore) and Dr. Huer (C. Montague Shaw).
